#load libraries
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

## install packages if you dont already have them
if (!require("tidyverse")) install.packages("tidyverse")
if (!require("plotrix")) install.packages("plotrix")

# load packages
library(plotrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

```

# Import data
```{r}
# Define function to read in chl data
read_chl <- function(file) {
  chl_data <- read_csv(file, skip = 24, n_max = 24) %>%
    select(-1) %>%
    magrittr::set_colnames(c("row", 1:12, "wavelength")) %>%
    fill(row) %>%
    gather("col", "absorbance", -wavelength, -row) %>%
    unite("well", c(row, col), sep = "")
}

# List chlorophyll data files
chl_path <- "data/chlorophyll/"                                        # Path to chlorophyll data directory
all_chl_files <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "*.csv")          # List all files in directory
chl_platemaps <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "platemap")       # List platemap files
chl_data_files <- setdiff(all_chl_files, chl_platemaps)                  # List absorbance data files

# Read in all files into tibble
df <- tibble(file = chl_data_files) %>%
  mutate(platemap = map(file, ~ read_csv(paste0(chl_path, tools::file_path_sans_ext(.), "_platemap.csv"))),
         chl_data = map(file, ~ read_chl(paste0(chl_path, .))))

# Merge platemap and data for each plate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(merged = map2(platemap, chl_data, ~ right_join(.x, .y)))
```

# Calculate chlorophyll concentrations
```{r}
# average all technical replicates for each plate/sample/wavelength, including all acetone blanks together (per plate)
df <- df %>%
  unnest(merged) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id)) %>%                         # remove empty wells (colony_id is NA)
  group_by(file, colony_id, wavelength) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_abs = mean(absorbance)) %>%
  spread(wavelength, mean_abs)

# subtract each sample's own 750 nm absorbance (turbidity/scatter correction) from its 630 and 663 values
# (the BLANK row is corrected the same way and removed later)
df <- df %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(adj630 = `630` - `750`,
         adj663 = `663` - `750`)

# calculate chla and chlc2 values based on equations from Jeffrey and Humphrey 1975
# units µg/ml
#path length adjustment = 0.6 

df <- df %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.ml = (11.43 * adj663)/0.6 - (0.64 * adj630)/0.6,
        chlc2.ug.ml = (27.09 * adj630)/0.6 - (3.63 * adj663)/0.6)

# Check for missing values
df %>% filter(is.na(chla.ug.ml))

# Distribution
summary(df$chla.ug.ml)
ggplot(df, aes(x = chla.ug.ml)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_rug()

# Flag outliers by IQR
chl_iqr_fence <- quantile(df$chla.ug.ml, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  1.5 * IQR(df$chla.ug.ml, na.rm = TRUE)
df %>% filter(chla.ug.ml > chl_iqr_fence) %>% arrange(desc(chla.ug.ml))

# Parse date and plate from file name, e.g., "20261023_Plate1_Chlorophyll.csv"
# Duplicates across plates are checked and resolved below, after joining metadata
df <- df %>%
  mutate(plate = str_remove(file, "_Chlorophyll\\.csv")) %>%
  separate(plate, into = c("date", "plate_num"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

write_csv(df, file = "output/chlorophyll_list.csv")

```


# Normalize to surface area
```{r}

#Calculate mean of duplicates
chl.mean <- df %>% 
  group_by(date, plate, plate_num, colony_id) %>%
  summarise(chla.ug.ml = mean(chla.ug.ml, na.rm = T),
            chlc2.ug.ml = mean(chlc2.ug.ml, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")

# Surface area data
sa <- read.csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")

# Tissue homogenate volume data
homog_vols <- read.csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") 

# Coral sample metadata
metadata <- read.csv("data/master_sample_info.csv") 

# Join homogenate volumes and surface area with sample metadata
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(select(homog_vols, colony_id, homog_vol_ml), by = "colony_id") %>%
  left_join(select(sa, colony_id, surface.area.cm2), by = "colony_id")

# Join chl data with metadata
chl.calc <- left_join(chl.mean, metadata, by="colony_id") 

# Extraction volumes — 1.0 mL homogenate subsampled and extracted into 1.0 mL acetone
homog_sample_vol_ml <- 1.0
acetone_vol_ml      <- 1.0

# Scale: chl (µg/mL acetone) × acetone vol → total chl in subsample
#        ÷ homog subsample vol × homog vol  → total chl in full homogenate
#        ÷ surface area                     → µg/cm²
chl <- chl.calc %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.cm2  = chla.ug.ml  * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2,
         chlc2.ug.cm2 = chlc2.ug.ml * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2)

# remove blanks and NAs
chl <- filter(chl, !colony_id %in% c("NA", "BLANK"))
```

# Check plate map sample IDs against metadata
```{r}
# Re-read plate maps (df has been summarised above) and keep occupied wells
pm_all <- tibble(file = chl_platemaps) %>%
  mutate(pm = map(file, ~ read_csv(paste0(chl_path, .x), show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  unnest(pm) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id))

# Plate map IDs with no match in metadata (excluding blanks): likely typos
pm_unmatched <- pm_all %>%
  filter(colony_id != "BLANK", !colony_id %in% metadata$colony_id) %>%
  distinct(file, well, colony_id)
pm_unmatched

# Metadata samples that do not appear on any plate map
missing_meta <- metadata %>%
  filter(!colony_id %in% pm_all$colony_id) %>%
  select(colony_id, site, genus)

cat(nrow(missing_meta), "of", n_distinct(metadata$colony_id),
    "metadata samples are missing from the plate maps\n")
missing_meta %>% count(site, genus)

write_csv(missing_meta, "output/missing_chl_from_platemaps.csv")
missing_meta
```



# Check for duplicates within and across plates
```{r}
# Within-plate duplicates (same colony_id appearing more than once on the same plate)
within_plate_dups <- chl %>%
  group_by(date, plate, colony_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(within_plate_dups) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(within_plate_dups), " within-plate duplicate(s) found:")
  print(within_plate_dups %>% select(date, plate, colony_id, chla.ug.cm2))
} else {
  cat("No within-plate duplicates found.\n")
}

# Across-plate duplicates (same colony_id run on more than one plate)
across_plate_dups <- chl %>%
  group_by(colony_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(across_plate_dups) > 0) {
  cat(n_distinct(across_plate_dups$colony_id), "colony_id(s) run on multiple plates:\n")
  print(across_plate_dups %>%
          select(date, plate, colony_id, chla.ug.cm2) %>%
          arrange(colony_id, date))
} else {
  cat("No across-plate duplicates found.\n")
}

```

```{r}
# Negative values are below detection: flag them, then set to 0
chl <- chl %>%
  mutate(chla.below.detection  = chla.ug.cm2  < 0,
         chlc2.below.detection = chlc2.ug.cm2 < 0,
         chla.ug.cm2  = if_else(chla.below.detection,  0, chla.ug.cm2),
         chlc2.ug.cm2 = if_else(chlc2.below.detection, 0, chlc2.ug.cm2))

# write chlorophyll data to file
chl <- chl %>%
  select(colony_id, genus, site, chla.ug.cm2, chlc2.ug.cm2,
         chla.below.detection, chlc2.below.detection) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chla.ug.cm2))%>%
  filter(!is.na(chlc2.ug.cm2))
write_csv(chl, "output/chlorophyll.csv")
```

#plot by genus and site
```{r}

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

plot_chl <- function(data, yvar, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = genus, y = .data[[yvar]], color = site, group = site)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", position = dodge) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", position = dodge) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1, position = dodge) +
    labs(x = "Genus", y = ylab, color = "Site") +
    theme_bw()
}

chla_plot  <- plot_chl(chl, "chla.ug.cm2",  expression("Chl-a (µg cm"^-2*")"))
chlc2_plot <- plot_chl(chl, "chlc2.ug.cm2", expression("Chl-c2 (µg cm"^-2*")"))

chl_combined <- chla_plot + chlc2_plot +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")

chl_combined

# Draw a shaded zoom region between the panels: dashed lines run from the right edge of
# panel A, at the heights of panel B's y-axis max and min on A's scale, to the top-left
# and bottom-left corners of panel B (shows the axis-limit difference)

add_axis_connector <- function(combined, plot_a, plot_b, col = "grey30") {
  g <- patchwork::patchworkGrob(combined)
  ra <- ggplot_build(plot_a)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y.range
  rb <- ggplot_build(plot_b)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y.range

  pan <- g$layout[grepl("^panel-[0-9]+$", g$layout$name), ]
  pan <- pan[order(pan$l), ]
  pa <- pan[1, ]; pb <- pan[2, ]

  # Heights within panel A (npc) of the values at the top and bottom of panel B's y axis
  y_top    <- (rb[2] - ra[1]) / diff(ra)
  y_bottom <- (rb[1] - ra[1]) / diff(ra)

  zoom <- grobTree(
    polygonGrob(x = c(0, 1, 1, 0), y = c(y_top, 1, 0, y_bottom),
                gp = gpar(fill = col, alpha = 0.12, col = NA)),
    segmentsGrob(x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = c(y_top, y_bottom), y1 = c(1, 0),
                 gp = gpar(col = col, lty = 2, lwd = 1))
  )
  # Span only the columns between the two panels
  gtable_add_grob(g, zoom, t = pa$t, b = pa$b, l = pa$r + 1, r = pb$l - 1,
                  z = Inf, clip = "off", name = "axis-connector")
}

chl_connected <- add_axis_connector(chl_combined, chla_plot, chlc2_plot)
grid.newpage(); grid.draw(chl_connected)

# Save both panels to a single PDF
pdf("output/chlorophyll_chla_chlc2.pdf", width = 10, height = 4.5)
grid.draw(chl_connected)
dev.off()


```
